`@interface UIDataPopup`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataPopup.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataPopup.java)

Annotation that makes a UI a popup, opened above the current screen with an opening and a closing transition.

## Description

A popup takes every input while it is open: nothing reaches the UIs below it.
Add `@UIData(background = true)` to dim what is under it.
A UI cannot be both a popup and an overlay.
